messages:
Alex Kim: Hey all — planning the RFC review session for Tue 10:00am PT. Need to slot 3 authors and confirm reviewers + pre-read reminders. Who can review which?
Maya Patel: I can attend Tue. Prefer earlier in the agenda.
Bryan O'Neil: I can take the serving/runtime RFC.
Sasha Li: I’ll take infra. @Alex can you ping the authors for pre-reads?
Alex Kim: Yep. Will ping now. Want to order by risk/size: infra -> serving -> UX? Thoughts.
Maya Patel: That order works. UX at the end so we don’t run over.
Bryan O'Neil: Agree. Also request authors upload pre-reads to the RFC folder and add a 1-paragraph TL;DR.
Alex Kim: Sending ping in 2 mins. Draft message below — please thumbs up if ok:
```
Hi @author — can you please upload your RFC draft + 1-paragraph TL;DR to the /rfc/reviews folder by EOD Fri? We'll review Tue 10am PT. Please highlight any specific questions you want reviewers to focus on.
Thanks!
```
Maya Patel: LGTM :thumbsup:
Sasha Li: Small ask — can we have a 5-min slot at the start for quick triage (if someone needs to swap)?
Alex Kim: Added 5-min buffer before the first talk. Also adding 10 min Q&A per RFC.
Bryan O'Neil: For serving RFC, I'll prepare two focused review points: perf regression risks and fallback behavior.
Alex Kim: Great. @review-bot can you send a calendar reminder with the agenda once authors confirm?
review-bot: Scheduled: RFC Review — Tue 10:00 PT. Agenda placeholder: 10:00 buffer + 10:05 infra (Sasha) + 10:25 serving (Bryan) + 10:45 UX + 11:05 wrap. Reminders set for Fri EOD (pre-read) and 30 min before meeting.
Maya Patel: Can we also include a short checklist for authors in the reminder: link to evals, perf numbers, migration plan?
Alex Kim: Good call. I'll paste a checklist into the calendar invite and the RFC folder.
Sasha Li: One more: if an author misses the pre-read deadline, can we move them to the last slot automatically?
Bryan O'Neil: Yes — rule: no pre-read = moved to last slot, unless urgent.
Alex Kim: Noted. I'll include that in the message to authors. Sending now.
Maya Patel: Thanks Alex. I'll review infra pre-read once it's up.
Alex Kim: Pinged authors. Copy of message in the folder. Will update thread if anyone needs to swap.
Sasha Li: Thanks. :raised_hands:
Bryan O'Neil: See you Tue.
Alex Kim: Closing loop — agenda + calendar updated. If you need to swap, reply here.
